title: Fix editability so users can paste photos and write letters/notes

requirements.text: Ensure all editable inputs on the slideshow are actually interactive (click/tap focuses, typing works) by preventing any global overlays/animations from intercepting pointer or touch events over form elements (Love Letters photo area + notes textarea, Page 8 letter textarea, Page 9 message textarea, Page 11 final note textarea).

quotes: Make this editable so i can paste pics and write letter

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile and desktop, the user can tap/click into each textarea (Page 8, Page 9, Page 11, and Love Letter notes) and type text without the click being swallowed by ambient/animation layers.
The Love Letter photo frame area can be focused/tapped and is not blocked by any overlay; the caret/focus ring appears when focused.
Ambient/background visual layers (e.g., floating hearts/sparkles) do not prevent interaction with any buttons or form fields.

requirements.text: Make the Love Letters (Page 5) photo slot reliably accept pasted images and provide a fallback for devices/browsers that do not support clipboard image paste (e.g., mobile) by adding an explicit user-initiated image picker option inside each opened LoveLetterCard.

quotes: Make this editable so i can paste pics and write letter

acceptanceCriteria: Desktop: when the user focuses the photo frame and pastes an image (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V), the pasted image is displayed in the frame for that specific letter.
Mobile: when the user taps the photo frame, they have a clear way to choose an image (file picker) and the selected image is displayed in the frame for that specific letter.
The existing notes textarea per opened letter remains editable and updates live as the user types.
No backend upload is required; the selected/pasted image is handled client-side only.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Keep the backend as single-actor Motoko; do not introduce additional backend services (no backend changes required for this request).
Use English for any new or updated user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding multi-user sharing, syncing, or permanent on-chain storage of pasted photos/typed letters.
Adding third-party integrations for storage or authentication beyond existing Internet Identity usage.
